# Financing the business {#sec-blp-finance}

> *Assessment objective 4: financing a business.*

::: {.callout-note title="Not yet written"}
Outline below.
:::

## Planned contents

**Equity finance** — allotment of shares (ss.549–551 CA 2006); pre-emption rights under s.561 and
their disapplication; transfer of shares and the directors' power to refuse registration; treasury
shares.

**Returning capital** — share buybacks out of distributable profits and out of capital; redemption;
reduction of capital by the solvency statement route. *Note: the September 2026 specification adds
detail on redemption and buyback exclusions — treat this as a signal that it is examinable.*

**Debt finance** — loans, overdrafts and debentures; the distinction between fixed and floating
charges and why it decides outcomes on insolvency; crystallisation; registration of charges under
s.859A and the consequence of failing to register.

**Distributions** — dividends; the requirement for profits available for distribution under s.830;
unlawful distributions and their recovery.

**Accounting requirements** — what the statutory accounts must contain, filing deadlines and
audit exemption thresholds.

**Conduct** — the solicitor acting on a financing where the lender and the borrower are both clients.
